Setting.LegendaryRulesText: Welcome to Legendary League! You've proven yourself one of the top-ranked captains in the galaxy, and have been entered into an exclusive matchmaking pool for captains in the Legend rank. Captains in the Legend rank trophy range gain no active immunity, only immunity from Items (One Day or Higher) and are allowed only a limited amount of battles a day, so make them count! Additionally, a failed attack attempt in Legendary League will not result in a loss of trophies, although failed defence battles will cause a deduction as normal.
Setting.LegendaryRewardsText: Captains in Legendary League face increased difficulty, but also much greater rewards. Loot rewards will be a set amount based on opponent level, rather than their stockpiles, and will grant more crew xp as well as item drops. In the event of a failed attack, attackers can gain partial rewards based on battle performance, even on battles that do not end in a victory. Finally, players that end a day with a net gain of trophies will receive up to 2 dove points.
